criteria.description: Analyzes all five forces — competitive rivalry, threat of new entrants, supplier power, buyer power, and threat of substitutes — not just listing competitors.
Rates each force (high/medium/low pressure) and gives the structural driver/reason behind the rating.
Identifies real substitutes that solve the need differently (e.g. groceries, restaurants/takeout, cooking from scratch) rather than only direct meal-kit rivals.
Gives an overall read of structural attractiveness and where the profit/margin pressure concentrates.
Ends with strategic implications — which forces threaten margins and what to do (or whether to enter), not just description.
